<page>
Dunn & Acosta LLP
Conroe, TX
Phone 713-555-4341
Letter of Representation
12 Nov 2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1217
Our client: Megan Gutierrez
Date of loss: 18 Oct 2023
Dear Claims Representative:
This office represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a
side-impact collision at an intersection. Our client was struck while proceeding
through the intersection and has since been receiving medical treatment for injuries
that are still being evaluated. Please direct all further communication regarding this
matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone,
mail, or in person.
We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued
to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and confirmation of
any other coverage that may apply. Please also confirm in writing that your insured has
been notified of this claim.
We further ask that the insurer preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This
icnludes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle inspection and
repair records, telematics or event data, dash camera footage if any exists, and all
communications with the insured or any third party. Please treat this request as a
formal notice to preserve such materials until this matter is fully resolved.
We look forward to your prompt response.
Sincerely,
Laura Bryant
Dunn & Acosta LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
